summary.en: Unofficial: OfficeAce (Huawei Cloud AgentArts) coding plans with Huawei Cloud OAuth sign-in — GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen3, openPangu and more, live models with credit rates, credit usage and daily check-in.
summary.zh: 非官方：OfficeAce（华为云 AgentArts）编码套餐，华为云 OAuth 登录；GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen3、openPangu 等 26 个模型，实时模型与积分倍率、积分用量和每日签到。

summary.en: A magpie / OpenCode provider plugin template with all of magpie's hooks implemented — sign-in, renewal, request takeover, usage, daily check-in, per-account models — and five TODO functions for the vendor-specific parts.
summary.zh: magpie / OpenCode 供应商插件模板，magpie 的钩子全实现（登录、续期、请求接管、额度、签到、每账号模型），厂商相关部分只留五个 TODO 函数。
